(${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL)), daily_dau AS (SELECT date(timestamp) AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau FROM filtered_chat WHERE date(timestamp) >= date('now', '-14 days') GROUP BY day), version_first_seen AS (SELECT user_id, MIN(date(timestamp)) AS first_day FROM filtered_chat GROUP BY user_id), daily_new AS (SELECT first_day AS day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM version_first_seen WHERE first_day >= date('now', '-14 days') GROUP BY day), cohort_users AS (SELECT first_day AS cohort_day, user_id FROM version_first_seen WHERE first_day >= date('now', '-21 days')), daily_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT date(timestamp) AS active_day, user_id FROM filtered_chat WHERE date(timestamp) >= date('now', '-21 days')), retention AS (SELECT c.cohort_day, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a1.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) AS ret_1, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a3.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) AS ret_3, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a7.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) AS ret_7 FROM cohort_users c LEFT JOIN daily_activity a1 ON c.user_id = a1.user_id AND a1.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+1 day') LEFT JOIN daily_activity a3 ON c.user_id = a3.user_id AND a3.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+3 day') LEFT JOIN daily_activity a7 ON c.user_id = a7.user_id AND a7.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+7 day') WHERE c.cohort_day <= date('now', '-1 day') GROUP BY c.cohort_day) SELECT d.day AS '日期', COALESCE(d.dau, 0) AS 'DAU', COALESCE(n.new_users, 0) AS '新增', COALESCE(r.ret_1, 0) AS '次留', COALESCE(r.ret_3, 0) AS '3日留', COALESCE(r.ret_7, 0) AS '7日留' FROM daily_dau d LEFT JOIN daily_new n ON d.day = n.day LEFT JOIN retention r ON d.day = r.cohort_day ORDER BY d.day DESC

END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) AS ret_7 FROM cohort_users c LEFT JOIN daily_activity a1 ON c.user_id = a1.user_id AND a1.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+1 day') LEFT JOIN daily_activity a3 ON c.user_id AS '7日留' FROM daily_dau d LEFT JOIN daily_new n ON d.day = n.day LEFT JOIN retention r ON d.day = r.cohort_day ORDER BY d.day DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(c.timestamp, '+8 hours') AS '时间(北京)', CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(c.client_version, '')) LIKE 'unity%' THEN 'Unity' WHEN COALESCE(c.client_version, '') = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'Non-Unity' END AS '客户端', COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '(empty)') AS '版本', COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, '') AS '昵称', c.user_id AS '用户ID', c.country AS '国家', c.user_query AS '玩家消息', c.ai_response AS 'AI回复', c.ai_action AS 'AI动作', c.duration_ms AS '延迟(ms)', c.prompt_tokens AS 'Prompt', c.completion_tokens AS 'Completion' FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_id LIKE '%${user_filter:raw}%' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (c.user_query != '' OR '$show_all' = 'true') ORDER BY c.timestamp DESC

targets.queryText: WITH chat_stats AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS chat_count, COUNT(DISTINCT date(c.timestamp)) AS days_played, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.session_id, ''), CAST(c.id AS TEXT))) AS selected_sessions, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '(empty)')) AS client_versions FROM conversations c WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY c.user_id) SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, '') AS '昵称', s.user_id AS '用户ID', CASE WHEN s.is_developer = 1 THEN '🔧' ELSE '' END AS 'DEV', chat_stats.client_versions AS '版本', s.country AS '国', chat_stats.chat_count AS '请求', s.total_requests AS '总请求', chat_stats.days_played AS '天数', chat_stats.selected_sessions AS '会话', s.session_count AS '总会话', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0, 1) AS '时长(分)', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 / MAX(COALESCE(chat_stats.days_played, 1), 1), 1) AS '日均(分)', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 / MAX(chat_stats.selected_sessions, 1), 1) AS '会话均(分)', s.island_level AS '岛Lv', s.money AS '金币', CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(s.last_seen) AS INTEGER) AS '距今天' FROM user_sessions s JOIN chat_stats ON s.user_id = chat_stats.user_id WHERE chat_stats.chat_count >= 2 ORDER BY chat_stats.chat_count DESC

targets.queryText: WITH active_users AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS selected_requests FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND c.user_id != '' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING selected_requests >= 2) SELECT '0-5分钟' AS range_label, 1 AS sort_order, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_sessions s JOIN active_users au ON s.user_id = au.user_id WHERE s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 < 5 UNION ALL SELECT '5-30分钟', 2, COUNT(*) FROM user_sessions s JOIN active_users au ON s.user_id = au.user_id WHERE s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 >= 5 AND s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 < 30 UNION ALL SELECT '30-60分钟', 3, COUNT(*) FROM user_sessions s JOIN active_users au ON s.user_id = au.user_id WHERE s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 >= 30 AND s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 < 60 UNION ALL SELECT '1-2小时', 4, COUNT(*) FROM user_sessions s JOIN active_users au ON s.user_id = au.user_id WHERE s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 >= 60 AND s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 < 120 UNION ALL SELECT '2-5小时', 5, COUNT(*) FROM user_sessions s JOIN active_users au ON s.user_id = au.user_id WHERE s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 >= 120 AND s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 < 300 UNION ALL SELECT '5小时以上', 6, COUNT(*) FROM user_sessions s JOIN active_users au ON s.user_id = au.user_id WHERE s.total_play_seconds / 60.0 >= 300 ORDER BY sort_order

panels.title: ⏰ 活跃时段分布 (北京时间)

targets.rawQueryText: WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS selected_requests, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.session_id, ''), CAST(c.id AS TEXT))) AS selected_sessions FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING selected_requests >= 5) SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(s.user_id, 1, 8)) AS 'User', ROUND(CAST(p.selected_requests AS FLOAT) / MAX(p.selected_sessions, 1), 1) AS 'Avg Requests/Session', p.selected_requests AS total_requests, p.selected_sessions AS session_count FROM per_user p JOIN user_sessions s ON p.user_id = s.user_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
targets.queryText: WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS selected_requests, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.session_id, ''), CAST(c.id AS TEXT))) AS selected_sessions FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING selected_requests >= 5) SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(s.user_id, 1, 8)) AS 'User', ROUND(CAST(p.selected_requests AS FLOAT) / MAX(p.selected_sessions, 1), 1) AS 'Avg Requests/Session', p.selected_requests AS total_requests, p.selected_sessions AS session_count FROM per_user p JOIN user_sessions s ON p.user_id = s.user_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(c.user_id, 1, 8)) AS 'User', ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.completion_tokens) AS FLOAT) / MAX(SUM(c.prompt_tokens), 1), 2) AS 'Output/Input Ratio', SUM(c.completion_tokens) AS 'Out', SUM(c.prompt_tokens) AS 'In' FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING SUM(c.prompt_tokens) > 500 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(c.user_id, 1, 8)) AS 'User', ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.completion_tokens) AS FLOAT) / MAX(SUM(c.prompt_tokens), 1), 2) AS 'Output/Input Ratio', SUM(c.completion_tokens) AS 'Out', SUM(c.prompt_tokens) AS 'In' FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING SUM(c.prompt_tokens) > 500 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 📈 用户增长 & 留存 DAU & Retention

targets.rawQueryText: WITH filtered_chat AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.timestamp, c.client_version FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' AND c.user_id != ''), first_day_users AS (SELECT user_id, MIN(date(timestamp)) AS first_day, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(client_version, ''), '(empty)')) AS client_versions FROM filtered_chat GROUP BY user_id), retained_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.user_id, f.first_day, date(c.timestamp) AS return_day, f.client_versions FROM first_day_users f JOIN filtered_chat c ON f.user_id = c.user_id WHERE date(c.timestamp) = date(f.first_day, '+1 day')) SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(r.user_id, 1, 8)) AS '用户', r.client_versions AS '版本', r.first_day AS '首日', r.return_day AS '次日', s.country AS '国家', s.total_requests AS '总请求', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0, 1) AS '游玩分钟', s.session_count AS '会话数' FROM retained_users r JOIN user_sessions s ON r.user_id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.total_requests DESC
targets.queryText: WITH filtered_chat AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.timestamp, c.client_version FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' AND c.user_id != ''), first_day_users AS (SELECT user_id, MIN(date(timestamp)) AS first_day, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(client_version, ''), '(empty)')) AS client_versions FROM filtered_chat GROUP BY user_id), retained_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.user_id, f.first_day, date(c.timestamp) AS return_day, f.client_versions FROM first_day_users f JOIN filtered_chat c ON f.user_id = c.user_id WHERE date(c.timestamp) = date(f.first_day, '+1 day')) SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(r.user_id, 1, 8)) AS '用户', r.client_versions AS '版本', r.first_day AS '首日', r.return_day AS '次日', s.country AS '国家', s.total_requests AS '总请求', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0, 1) AS '游玩分钟', s.session_count AS '会话数' FROM retained_users r JOIN user_sessions s ON r.user_id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.total_requests DESC

targets.rawQueryText: WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY c.user_id) SELECT '1次' AS bucket, 1 AS sort_order, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '2-5次', 2, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '6-20次', 3, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '21-100次', 4, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count BETWEEN 21 AND 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '100+次', 5, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user ORDER BY sort_order
targets.queryText: WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY c.user_id) SELECT '1次' AS bucket, 1 AS sort_order, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '2-5次', 2, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '6-20次', 3, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '21-100次', 4, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count BETWEEN 21 AND 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user UNION ALL SELECT '100+次', 5, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per_user ORDER BY sort_order

panels.title: 📊 真实用户对话分布 (排除开发者)

targets.rawQueryText: WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_requests FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY c.user_id), ranked AS (SELECT user_id, total_requests, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_requests DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total FROM per_user), top10 AS (SELECT SUM(total_requests) AS top_vol FROM ranked WHERE rn <= MAX(total * 0.1, 1)), all_vol AS (SELECT SUM(total_requests) AS total_vol FROM per_user) SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * top10.top_vol / NULLIF(all_vol.total_vol, 0), 1), 0) AS pct FROM top10, all_vol
targets.queryText: WITH per_user AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_requests FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY c.user_id), ranked AS (SELECT user_id, total_requests, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_requests DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total FROM per_user), top10 AS (SELECT SUM(total_requests) AS top_vol FROM ranked WHERE rn <= MAX(total * 0.1, 1)), all_vol AS (SELECT SUM(total_requests) AS total_vol FROM per_user) SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * top10.top_vol / NULLIF(all_vol.total_vol, 0), 1), 0) AS pct FROM top10, all_vol

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT user_query AS '玩家消息', COUNT(*) AS '次数' FROM conversations WHERE is_preset = 0 AND user_query != '' AND LENGTH(user_query) > 1 AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY user_query ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: 🔥 热门玩家消息 Top 30 (排除预设)

targets.rawQueryText: WITH version_stats AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS chat_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '(empty)')) AS client_versions FROM conversations c WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY c.user_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.money DESC) AS '排名', COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, 'anonymous') AS '昵称', version_stats.client_versions AS '版本', s.money AS '金币', s.island_level AS '等级', (CAST(s.tasks_completed AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(s.tasks_total AS TEXT)) AS '任务进度', s.current_task_title AS '当前任务', s.current_task_status AS '任务状态', (CAST(s.achievements_unlocked AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(s.achievements_total AS TEXT)) AS '成就', s.country AS '国家', version_stats.chat_count AS '请求数', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0, 1) AS '游玩分钟' FROM user_sessions s JOIN version_stats ON s.user_id = version_stats.user_id WHERE (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND (s.is_blacklisted = 0 OR s.is_blacklisted IS NULL) AND s.user_id != 'anonymous_user' AND s.user_id != '' ORDER BY s.money DESC
targets.queryText: WITH version_stats AS (SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS chat_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '(empty)')) AS client_versions FROM conversations c WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND ('__all__' IN (${client_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_version, ''), '__empty__') IN (${client_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY c.user_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.money DESC) AS '排名', COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, 'anonymous') AS '昵称', version_stats.client_versions AS '版本', s.money AS '金币', s.island_level AS '等级', (CAST(s.tasks_completed AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(s.tasks_total AS TEXT)) AS '任务进度', s.current_task_title AS '当前任务', s.current_task_status AS '任务状态', (CAST(s.achievements_unlocked AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(s.achievements_total AS TEXT)) AS '成就', s.country AS '国家', version_stats.chat_count AS '请求数', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0, 1) AS '游玩分钟' FROM user_sessions s JOIN version_stats ON s.user_id = version_stats.user_id WHERE (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND (s.is_blacklisted = 0 OR s.is_blacklisted IS NULL) AND s.user_id != 'anonymous_user' AND s.user_id != '' ORDER BY s.money DESC

list.definition: SELECT display AS __text, value AS __value FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(client_version, ''), '(empty)') AS display, COALESCE(NULLIF(client_version, ''), '__empty__') AS value FROM conversations GROUP BY client_version) versions ORDER BY CASE WHEN lower(value) LIKE 'unity%' THEN 0 WHEN value = 'dev' THEN 1 WHEN value = '__empty__' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, value
